name: Transcribe audio or video
description: Transcribe speech from an audio or video file owned by the current user (local-first STT with cloud fallback). Returns verbatim text plus professional segments, SRT/VTT subtitles, speaker labels when diarization is available, and can save the transcript as TXT/SRT/VTT/JSON.

fileId.description: Optional id of an audio or video file owned by the user. Defaults to attached media.

language.description: Optional ISO language hint such as es or en (600+ catalogue, auto-detect by default).

prompt.description: Optional vocabulary or context hint for transcription.

diarize.description: Request speaker labels (SPEAKER_00…) when the STT backend supports diarization. Default false.

format.description: Transcript artifact format when saveTranscript is true. Default txt.

saveTranscript.description: Save the transcript as a downloadable artifact. Default false.
